integrity: Proof and a reproducible standard-library checker are supplied. Exact checks support the witnesses; the universal result rests on an analytic proof. Independent validation is not claimed. Historical priority remains literature-bounded.
limitations: The result concerns the household reproduction threshold in a two-type, equally balanced, two-person SIR model with deterministic infectious periods and Poisson contacts; it does not order outbreak probabilities, final attack sizes or individual-level reproduction numbers.
title: A unique household-assortativity crossover under opposing transmission traits
